name: What is included in a typical interior painting service?
description: Interior painting service includes surface preparation, priming, two coats of paint, protection of your belongings, and cleanup.

mainEntity.name: What is included in a typical interior painting service?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard interior painting service typically includes surface preparation, such as cleaning, sanding, and patching minor imperfections. We then apply primer as needed, followed by two coats of high-quality paint. Our team also handles masking and protecting your furniture and flooring, and a thorough cleanup after the project is complete. This ensures a smooth, durable, and aesthetically pleasing finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Interior painting service includes surface preparation, priming, two coats of paint, protection of your belongings, and cleanup.
